The '''SkyHawks''' was a [[Swoop gang/Legends|speeder bike gang]] that operated on [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It's members rode [[MVR-3 speeder bike]]s and they were friendly with [[Fallon (Human)|Fallon]], a teenager who led the street gang [[Borus's Boys]].
